title: hub: flaky acceptance test outbox race
description: tests/hub_acceptance.rs::room_lifecycle_across_restart (S10, on main) fails intermittently at L1228 (attempts 0 vs 1): the test reads the outbox as soon as the mock peer has received the request, before the fanout worker records the attempt. Fails 2/13 on unmodified 66dff4d, more often under load (F0 saw 4/5). Fix the synchronization (wait for the attempt to be recorded / worker pass to finish); no assertion weakened.
notes: Investigated 2026-10-18: test race only, no production bug (H19 holds). Mock signals arrival before sending the 503; test reads outbox before worker's record_attempt. 10/30 failures all showed the untouched enqueue row; with a poll for attempts != 0 then the unchanged strict assert: 0/30. Mark approved the test-only fix.
